text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py's reserve_stock, added a warehouse_id validation check before the existing ValueError checks and before load_ledger(): if not is_valid_warehouse_id(warehouse_id), it raises ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\"). is_valid_warehouse_id is imported from core.ids (reusing the WH-RRR-NN regex/region/number rules). Because the check runs before any ledger load or mutation, rejected codes like WH7 record nothing in the ledger, while valid codes like WH-HGL-07 continue to work unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
